value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — key_lost is defined as the key lost before the door was opened, so the ban is a plain Absence, and 'try not to' correctly makes it soft; the hard Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box pickup, and the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) puts opening the door before it, which together also force door_open without a redundant Existence(door_open).

texts: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

Pick up the box in the other room.
